external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who manually update loan and account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: The phone application members use to borrow, renew and reserve books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API through which loans are accessed and changed.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note: 'The lending API is internal-only.' Interview transcript: 'The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.' These are conflicting positive claims, so exposure is unknown.

processes.name: Circulation page
processes.description: The page desk staff use to manually extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
processes.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, contact details and borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The speaker corrected the earlier statement about two databases: 'We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone.'

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to request borrowing, renewal or reservation actions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: manage loans
data_flows.description: The library app sends book and member details and requests loan or reservation changes to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Authentication is uncertain: Priya said, 'I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look.'
data_flows.data_description: Member, book, loan renewal and reservation request data

data_flows.name: send loans
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.notes: Priya could not say whether the kiosks communicate directly with the loans database: 'I couldn't tell you what they talk to these days. I only ever see what arrives at the API.'
data_flows.data_description: Member card, book, loan and return data

data_flows.name: manage account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page to extend loans, clear blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The page uses one shared desk login. The password is on a card taped under the desk, and individual staff or branches cannot be identified.

data_flows.name: update loan
data_flows.description: The circulation page submits manual loan and account changes to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page is served by the lending API. The shared desk login is not attributable to an individual or branch.

data_flows.name: read and write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes member, loan and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network used by branch kiosks and desk staff.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full member borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The interview states that the database contains personal contact details and each member's full borrowing history.

assumptions.assumption: The circulation page presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source describes desk staff opening and using a circulation page served by the lending API.
